GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311.2 (10 Dec 49) CCS
(SCAPIN-2063)
APO 500
10 December 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Establishment and Operation of Direct Radiotelegraph Circuit Between Japan and the Zones in Germany Occupied By the United States, United Kingdom and France.
1. The Japanese Government, Ministry of Telecommunications, is authorized, effective upon receipt of this memorandum, to establish and operate a direct radiotelegraph circuit between Japan and the zones in Germany occupied by the United States. United Kingdom and France, subject to agreement between the participating administrations and approval by the Supreme Contender for the Allied Powers, concerning operating and service details.
2. Direct communication between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications, concerning matters within the scope of this memorandum is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
K.B.BUSH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
